QuestInfo.name: Quieting Wraiths
QuestInfo.0: Something seems to be bothering Ryden. What could have happened? Go talk to #bRyden#k.
QuestInfo.1: Recently, Lady Syl hasn't been able to get any sleep, because of the Wraiths who haunt her dreams every night. You need to eliminate the Wraiths, so Lady Syl can have some peace and quiet at night. Eliminate the #rWraiths#k in #bKerning City Subway#k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Wraiths to help Lady Syl sleep better at night.
